# National Strategic Partnerships

# Why Partner with Us?

Whether you’re interested in product sampling or demonstrations, STEAM and
learning experiences, camp operations, outdoor adventure, sustainability
initiatives, or finding your next generation of leaders, Scouting America has
an audience for you!

# All the Ways to Engage

![](https://www.scouting.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/10/local-
activity.svg)![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns=%22http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%22%20viewBox=%220%200%2080%2080%22%3E%3C/svg%3E)

Connect with Scouts

From ages 5-17+ years through a variety of program sponsorship opportunities
like Cub Scouts adventure awards by grade level, merit badge sponsorships, the
iconic Pinewood Derby events, Eagle Scout projects, and exciting initiatives
like saving the planet and sending people to Space!

![](https://www.scouting.org/wp-
content/uploads/2024/10/celebration.svg)![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns=%22http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%22%20viewBox=%220%200%2080%2080%22%3E%3C/svg%3E)

Become a part of the action

Become a part of the action by participating in our national events! National
consumer events host 6,000-40,000 Scouts and adult volunteers and world-class
outdoor adventures. Find the next generation of your workforce or showcase
branded installations, sampling zones, and interactive experiences. Our
national events host hundreds to thousands of Scouting America’s top
leadership and include decision makers from fundraising, licensing, supply,
and marketing departments.

![](https://www.scouting.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/10/family-
rep.svg)![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns=%22http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%22%20viewBox=%220%200%2080%2080%22%3E%3C/svg%3E)

Our four high-adventure bases

Across the country offer opportunities to market to Scouts, units, families,
and even non-Scouters through unique high adventures offered onsite. We’ll
work with you to create impactful moments through experiences that fuel
connections between your brand and these captive audiences.

# Why Work with Us?

Since its inception in 1910, Scouting America is one of the nation’s largest
and most prominent values-based youth development organizations. The
organization provides a program for young people that builds character, trains
them in the responsibilities of participating in citizenship, and develops
personal fitness to prepare them for a life of impact and purpose.

#### Our Mission

The mission of Scouting America is to prepare young people to make ethical and
moral choices over their lifetimes by instilling in them the values of the
Scout Oath and Scout Law.

#### Scout Oath

On my honor I will do my best to do my duty to God and my country and to obey
the Scout Law; to help other people at all times; to keep myself physically
strong, mentally awake, and morally straight.

#### Scout Law

A Scout is trustworthy, loyal, helpful, friendly, courteous, kind, obedient,
cheerful, thrifty, brave, clean, and reverent.
